title: P15.9-B5.5: /app/system/* — Providers, Observability, Schedules, Cost & Settings (canonical reads)
description: P15.9-B5.5 — replaces the five remaining /app/system/* placeholders with functional pages on canonical reads. Providers & Models (/api/providers + /api/models + /api/routes, read-only): per-section loading/error states, credential_status as configuration metadata (never routability evidence, never a secret), canonical gate values verbatim (UNKNOWN/missing never coerced to PASS), bounded routing-decision subset labeled. Observability: global /api/events SSE via eventBus (live/reconnecting/unavailable distinct, never business-scoped), routing + recovery explorers (recovery != mission schedules), evidence explorer pinned to the selected mission (AbortController + generation guard; late A never paints under B), safe JSON export. Schedules: global unfiltered registry labeled, UTC cron semantics prominent, deleted rows hidden+counted, create/enable/disable/delete each behind ConfirmDialog with pinned schedule identity + consequence, single-flight POSTs, no optimistic success, canonical refetch, honest ambiguous outcome, zero /api/tick. Cost & Usage: remote-dispatch guard labeled DEVIN executor_execution count (not tokens/spend), monetary position preserves HELD/COMMITTED/SETTLED + unpriced with exact micro-USD conversion, policies/profiles read-only with envelope+element validation (malformed never becomes fabricated empty). Settings: masked token editor (stored value never rendered, configured indicator, clear behind confirmation), operator id propagating to headers + shell chip via change event, theme synced with pair.theme, legacy UI link, SSE reconnect on credential change; no new auth backend, zero credential/cost mutations. eventBus gains reconnectStream; useTheme + OperatorChip gain sync listeners. UI-only; zero backend/schema/dependency changes.
